title: Young Voters Helped Trump Win. How Do They Feel Now? | WSJ
summary: WSJ field piece on young South Carolina voters; mostly polling and anecdotes, with gas prices from the Iran war named as the main economic grievance.

assertions.quote: it directly is affecting our gas prices and our cost of living domestically
I think if the Trump administration is successful, which I think they will be in these various areas, I think they will go down.

verdicts.note: Prediction conditional on an undefined success; pump prices track crude, which depends on when and how Hormuz traffic resumes.
